title: Prayer times

unavailable: No prayer times for this location today
settings.title: Settings
settings.manual: Use exact coordinates for a place outside the offline city list. The timezone belongs to this plugin only.
settings.invalid: Enter a number within the indicated range.
settings.adjust: Extra minutes per time (−60 to +60), added to the profile’s margins.
settings.computed: Calculated times may differ from local published timetables. Morocco preserves the original plugin’s angles and margins. Umm al-Qura’s Ramadan interval uses the adjustable calculated Hijri date.
settings.quiet: Respects Do Not Disturb. After sleep: one silent reminder within 15 minutes of a prayer, never a backlog.
settings.hijriNote: Official Hijri dates are checked online hourly; no coordinates are sent. Morocco’s Habous calendar is currently supported. Other authorities show unverified. Cached confirmed dates work offline; month boundaries are never guessed.
city.offline: Offline timezone reference cities. For your exact location, use manual coordinates.
city.noMatch: No match. Use manual coordinates below.
city.profile: Suggested profile — choose the one you follow.
fasting.unavailable: Fasting times unavailable for this location
times.estimated: ≈ Estimated using your high-latitude rule or an unverified Ramadan interval.
times.unavailable: — The selected rules cannot calculate every time here. Review the location or high-latitude settings.
